description: Parse a database connection URI (postgres://, mysql://, mongodb://, mongodb+srv://, redis://, amqp://, and similar generic scheme:// connection strings) into its scheme, credentials, one or more hosts (mongodb-style comma-separated host lists included), database/path, and query parameters. Pure offline parse: never connects, resolves DNS, or validates the driver/scheme combination.

connectionString.description: The database connection string to parse

name: parse_connection_string
